topic.title: Adding Comments in Markdown Documents
topic.shortdesc: You can add comments over selected content in Markdown documents, reply to them, and remove them. The comments are saved in the document as HTML comments, so the Markdown content itself is not changed.

body.p: Comments are useful for reviewing Markdown documents. Each comment is attached to a selection of content and is recorded together with the name of its author and the time when it was added. The author name is the one specified in the Review preferences page.

section.title: Adding a Comment
section.p:
To add a comment:
Select the content you want to comment on. A comment can only be added over a selection.
Select the Add Comment action from the Markdown toolbar or from the contextual menu.
Type the comment in the dialog box that opens and click OK.

The commented content is highlighted and a marker is displayed in the vertical stripe on the right side of the editor. Hovering over the commented content or over its marker displays the comment, its author, and the time when it was added. The comments are rendered with the colors that are used for the comments in Author mode, as configured in the Review preferences page.

section.title: Replying to a Comment
section.p: To reply to a comment, place the cursor inside the commented content, right-click, and select Add Reply from the contextual menu. The replies are presented together with the comment they reply to when you hover over the commented content.

section.title: Removing a Comment
section.p: To remove a comment, place the cursor inside the commented content, right-click, and select Remove Comment from the contextual menu. The comment is removed together with all its replies. If several comments are added over the same content, the innermost one is removed.
If you delete all the content that a comment was added over, the comment is also removed.
section.note: Adding a comment, adding a reply, and removing a comment can be undone and redone, just like any other editing action.

section.title: How Comments are Saved
section.p: The comments are saved in the Markdown document as pairs of HTML comments placed around the commented content. For example:
section.codeblock: Some <!--oxy_comment_start author="john" timestamp="20260908T161113+0300" comment="Please review"-->commented<!--oxy_comment_end--> text.
section.p: The editor does not display these HTML comments. It presents them as highlights over the commented content instead. When a comment starts or ends at the beginning of a line, its HTML comment is saved on a separate line.
The Preview pane renders the document as it is saved, including the comments, and it is refreshed when you add or remove a comment.

section.title: Turning Off Comments
section.p: You can turn off the comments by deselecting the Enable comments option in the Markdown preferences page. When the comments are turned off, no comments can be added and the HTML comments that are already in a document are displayed in the editor as regular content.
